title: Enterprise Connectivity: rounding convention
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following rounding convention for each named contract tier. Decimal tie-breaking convention for monetary and quantity rounding; string.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | rounding convention | half-up |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | rounding convention | half-up |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | rounding convention | half-up |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | rounding convention | half-up |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | rounding convention | half-up |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | rounding convention | half-up |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the rounding convention is half-up.
